thread:
Tasha (Product): Heads-up: customers keep pushing for route-level cost + lightweight tracing + error samples in the console. Need to define MVP scope and concrete launch gates this week.

Ilan (Eng-runtime): Feasible. My quick take: cost card (route/model) + async trace hook + basic error grouping. Sampling default 0.5%.

Pri (Eng-SRE): Ops constraints: per-org daily cap, retention presets (7/30/90d), and an autoscale plan for trace consumers. Rollback if trace ingestion > 2x forecast.
Maya (Design): UI: compact cost list with sparkline, trace table with latency tag, error groups w/ sample toggle (redacted). I'll sketch mobile & desktop variants.

Omar (Data): Schema: tags = org_id, route_id, model, variant; fields = tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, outcome. Cost formula = tokens * model.unit_cost + est infra. Backfill: opt-in 30d batch.

Tasha (Product): Proposed launch gates: (1) cost variance <7% vs billing for beta orgs, (2) trace capture <=10% p99 regression, (3) error groups show top-5 and include example for >=80% groups. Canary: 3 customers + internal.

Ilan (Eng-runtime): Implementation notes: non-blocking plugin, async uploader, sampling rules by route/latency/org. Example: default 0.005, override for slow routes.

Pri (Eng-SRE): Action items: I will size infra if PMs provide span/day estimate for beta orgs. Also adding alerts for sudden error/trace spikes.

infra-bot: Ticket OBS-5804 created: "Console: route cost + tracing MVP" -> https://redwood.example/OBS-5804

Tasha (Product): Thanks. Action owners: Ilan (RFC + ETA), Pri (sizing + alerts), Omar (schema + backfill plan), Maya (mocks). I'll circulate the launch criteria doc after RFCs land.
